_comment: Story & system changes per version, from the developer's official version announcement. Keyed by version; /version renders the section only when an entry exists for the current version. 3.8 source: Kuro Games' official Version 3.8 announcement (press release, 2026-11-06), as carried by Final Weapon, PSU and Inven Global; Calamity Effigy detail from Kuro’s official post of 2026-11-10 and Game8’s 3.8 summary.

3.8.text: The main story boards the Soul Train, which carries the spirits of those lost in the Resonator War — and starts setting the stage for Version 4.0.
3.8.title: Chapter IV Act V — “A Bouquet for Tomorrow”

3.8.text: Unlocks at Union Level 27, once you activate the Four Chime Shaftpost during the main quest “The Wind Before the Storm”. The Effigy resists Aero: its Forged Might mechanism builds Impeccable stacks for more damage, and the Way of the Forged Empyrean timer raises damage dealt and taken the longer the fight runs. Six difficulties, started from the Guidebook; first clears pay 120 Astrite in total, a Calamity Effigy icon, Sparring Coins, Premium Tuners and Shell Credit. Details from Kuro’s official post (Nov 10), Game8 and the wiki, cross-checked Nov 13.
3.8.title: Tactical Hologram: Calamity Effigy

3.8.text: Switching Rover's attribute now auto-equips the Echo set saved for that attribute. Each attribute keeps its own set — no more re-equipping by hand after every conversion.
3.8.title: Resonance Conversion, reworked

3.8.text: A Material Locator button in the Guidebook and the Ascension Planner jumps you to the challenge that drops what you need. Blitz Mode restarts a cleared challenge the moment you claim its rewards. Kuro is rolling these out gradually, as a limited test.
3.8.title: Material Locator + Blitz Mode

3.8.text: PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) support arrives for PS5 Pro players.
3.8.title: PS5 Pro PSSR support
